findings.message: The per-socket summary printed by scripts/build-map.ts (the report.finalSockets.forEach console.log block) is never run by any policy check. typecheck only compiles it: tsconfig.json includes scripts/**. test:unit, test:integration and build never call map:build or map:check, and the worker's manual map:check run isn't in the candidate packet. The values it prints (sector, worst spawn time, circle count) are asserted in maps.test.ts ('has four hidden final-island sockets…' checks sectors, worstSpawn <= 90 s, circle >= 12, and sliceReport().finalSockets equal to validateFinalSockets). What no check covers is that the script actually prints them.
findings.requirement: `npm run map:build` prints each socket's sector, its worst travel time from a spawn, and its circle's navigable tile count.
